body.p: A fox stole butter of [some] Russians, at an ice hole it met a wolf and said: "I take tallow out of the icehole with my tail. Put your tail into the ice hole by night, then you'll take tallow." The wolf put ins tail into the water, it was night. In the morning Evenki people went for water; the wolf, when it saw [them], started to fidget, it pulled its tail and tore it off.
